name: airpods-noise-control
title: AirPods Noise Control
description: Switch between Off, Transparency, Adaptive or Noise Cancellation on your AirPods. Toggle Conversation Awareness on AirPods that support it.
author: chrahe

commands.name: index
commands.title: Switch Noise Control Mode
commands.subtitle: Off ↔ Transparency ↔ Adaptive ↔ Noise Cancellation
commands.description: This command will switch Off, Transparency, Adaptive or Noise Cancellation if AirPods are connected to your device.

commands.name: toggle-conversation-awareness
commands.title: Toggle Conversation Awareness
commands.subtitle: On ↔ Off
commands.description: This command will toggle between Conversation Awareness (on/off) if AirPods are connected to your device.

preferences.name: airpodsIndex
preferences.title: AirPods List Position
preferences.description: When your AirPods are connected, at which position are they listed in your Sound menu? (1, 2, 3, etc.)
preferences.placeholder: Position of your AirPods in the Sound menu (1, 2, 3, ...)

preferences.name: airpodsType
preferences.title: AirPods Type
preferences.description: Select your AirPods model. This affects the menu layout for noise control options.

preferences.name: soundLoc
preferences.title: Sound Menu Localization
preferences.description: What is the name of the Sound menu bar icon in your language/region?

preferences.name: optionOne
preferences.title: Option One 🔵
preferences.description: First noise control mode to switch between

preferences.name: optionTwo
preferences.title: Option Two 🟢
preferences.description: Second noise control mode to switch between

preferences.name: showHudNC
preferences.title: Show HUD For Noise Control
preferences.description: Show heads-up display when switching noise control modes
preferences.label: Show HUD

preferences.name: showHudCA
preferences.title: Show HUD For Conversation Awareness
preferences.description: Show heads-up display when toggling conversation awareness
preferences.label: Show HUD
